name: Latobius

attributes.attribute: linked to Mars by the Romans

sources: Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.
text: Latobius is a Continental Celtic god. Only a few inscriptions carry his name. The Romans set him beside their war god Mars. Nobody has yet translated his name.

key_results: He was a Continental Celtic god.
The Romans equated him with Mars.
